Commentary.Commentary: We are back. The hosts have a massive task on their hands. A good start is needed, Litton Das and Soumya Sarkar to open. Angelo Mathews to bowl first.
THE CHASE...

Bangladesh were surely not thinking of chasing over 200 when they put Lanka into bat. Also, after the start they got, they would have been very pleased but it was the middle and the death overs where their bowlers faulterrd. The two spinners were quite expensive and towards the end, their pacers leaked a lot of runs too. Their batters now face a stiff challenge ahead but the wicket is good and there is dew but they'll still need to bat well. Lanka on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this.

That is a brilliant batting effort by the hosts and they’ll be very pleased with where they are in the game. The start wasn’t the best as they lost a wicket in the first over itself. Kamindu and Kusal then tried to steady the ship but Kamindu fell. Then though came the stand which turned the tide into Lanka’s favor. The partnership between Mendis and Sadeera. They added just under a 100. The two got used to the pace off the surface and once they did, scored quickly. Mendis fell after getting to a half ton but Sadeera continued. He along with Asalanka added the finishing touches and took them over the 200-run mark.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Wonderful timing! That is very nicely played! This is tossed up around off, this is a little too full. Mendis leans into it and strokes it past cover. This one races away to the fence. Yet again a boundary to start the over. Runs coming now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Mahedi Hasan to Kusal Mendis, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Mahedi Hasan to bowl now.

FOUR! Up and over! That is hit with authority! Top shot. KM looks in good touch here. This is on a length and outside off. Mendis stands tall and slams it over the cover fielder. Races away. A good over in the end for Lanka. One they needed.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: A loud shout but not given! Review taken but it seems to be pitching outside leg. NOT OUT! It has indeed pitched outside leg! On the pads. Mendis looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A run taken. That is a poor review.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Shoriful Islam to Kusal Mendis, Leg bye.

Commentary.Commentary: Another dot! Good comeback from Islam so far after going for a biggie. Fuller and outside off. Mendis looks to drive but it goes off the inner half to mid off. Can he end it well now?
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Shoriful Islam to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Kusal misses out! This is short and on the body. Mendis looks to flick but misses. It hits the body and rolls to the short fine leg fielder.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Shoriful Islam to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle. Kamindu works it around the corner and gets to the other end.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! All the way! Much needed as the pressure was building. Angled into the pads. No swing and and it is an easy pick up shot and it sails over the square leg fence. First of the game. Good start to the over. They can now make it a big one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end. Tidy from Taskin. On middle, blocked.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Taskin Ahmed to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Quick single! Good length and on middle, Mendis lets the  come to him and then plays it to mid on for one. This is how you need to bat in such conditions, need to play it late.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Taskin Ahmed to Kamindu Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lands short. Outside off, length. Kudal pushes it to mid on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Taskin Ahmed to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish and around off, Mendis looks to drive, not foot movement, it goes off the inner half on the leg side for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Taskin Ahmed to Kamindu Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A lot of movement there. Fuller and outside off. This shapes away a long way. Mendis goes after it but misses. The keeper dives to his left and takes it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Taskin Ahmed to Kamindu Mendis, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! Around off and on a length, Mendis looks to defend but it goes more off the outer half down to third man for one. He is off the mark.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Taskin Ahmed to Kusal Mendis, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: That is a beauty! Brilliant to begin with by Taskin. This is on a length and around off, it lands and moves away. Mendis is beaten all ends up as he tries to defend. Taskin in fact was not at his best in the BPL but he will be licking his lips after looking at this wicket and the first ball.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Taskin Ahmed to Kusal Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin Ahmed to bowl from the other end.

That is a top class first over from Islam. A wicket and just the four runs from it. Top stuff. He has been in good form in the recently concluded BPL and has began well. On off, good length, defended.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish and around off, Mendis drives but to point. Can he end the over well now?
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, good length, this is driven but to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Leading edge but safe! What an action packed start to the game. This is on the pads. Yet again. No swing. Mendis looks to work it on the leg side but the ball holds in the surface. It goes off the leading edge back but wide of the stretched hand of the bowler and to mid on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Shoriful Islam to Kamindu Mendis, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! This time it is straight to the keeper and Islam strikes on the second ball itself. This is fuller again. This is around off and slanting away. Fernando is probably worried about the ball coming back in and looks to play it towards mid on. It goes off the outside edge and the keeper takes it. Perfect start for Bangladesh.
Commentary.Howout: c Litton Das b Shoriful Islam
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Shoriful Islam to Avishka Fernando, OUT! c Litton Das b Shoriful Islam.

Commentary.Commentary: EDGE AND FOUR! That is quite strange! First ball of the game, a green wicket and there is no slip and it goes through there. It is full and outside off. Fernando looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence. Off the mark in a streaky manner.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Shoriful Islam to Avishka Fernando, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: All set for action. The players are out in the middle. Avishka Fernando and Kusal Mendis to open for the Lankans. Shoriful Islam to bowl first.

Najmul Hossain Shanto says they want to bowl as there might be few later on. Adds they have good players and informs about their combination. Charith Asalanka says 170 plus will be a good score. Adds they want to play well before the World Cup and they are quite focused.

Pitch Report! Russel Arnold says most of the matches have been won by the chasing team. Adds there is nice covering of grass and the seamers will get some purchase on it. Reckons team batting first should target a score of around 180-190.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis (WK), Kamindu Mendis, Sadeera Samarawickrama, Charith Asalanka (C), Angelo Mathews, Dasun Shanaka, Maheesh Theekshana, Akila Dananjaya, Binura Fernando, Matheesha Pathirana.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Najmul Hossain Shanto (C), Litton Das (WK), Soumya Sarkar, Towhid Hridoy, Jaker Ali, Mahmudullah, Mahedi Hasan, Mustafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Rishad Hossain.
Toss- Bangladesh have won the toss and will bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the first of the three T20Is between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Two Asian rivals go against each other as they gear up for the upcoming T20 World Cup. Bangladesh will be without the experience of Tamim Iqbal, Shakib Al Hasan and Rahim. On the other hand, the visitors will be without Wanindu Hasaranga and Nissanka. Despite missing some key players, both teams have exciting guns to look forward to. Who are you backing? Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

The Bangladesh Premier League 2024 just concluded, leaving fans craving more cricket action, and they won't be disappointed as an electrifying three-match T20I series between Bangladesh and Sri Lanka is set to unfold. All matches will light up the Sylhet International Cricket Stadium. Former rivals from the domestic league, Bangladeshi players now unite to tackle the Lankan challenge. With the ICC Men’s T20I World Cup 2024 looming, both teams aim to sharpen their skills and strategies in this thrilling encounter. Bangladesh last clashed in a T20I series against New Zealand, ending in a draw. However, they've revamped their squad, missing key all-rounder Shakib Al Hasan. Mahmudullah, absent from T20Is for over a year, earned his spot with dazzling performances in BPL 2024, amassing 237 runs, including two half-centuries. Anamul Haque and Mohammad Naim bolster the batting order, while Litton Das and Soumya Sarkar are expected to lead the charge. Mustafizur Rahman spearheads the pace attack alongside Shoriful Islam, with Taskin Ahmed​​​​​'s inclusion fortifying their ranks. Taijul Islam and Tanzim Hasan Sakib handle spin duties. Sri Lanka, buoyant from recent series victories against Afghanistan and Zimbabwe, face a leadership void as skipper Wanindu Hasaranga sits out the first two games due to an ICC ban for misconduct against an umpire. In his absence, Charith Asalanka assumes leadership. While Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Perera are unavailable, Niroshan Dickwella and Avishka Fernando step in, eager to seize the opportunity with the T20 World Cup approaching. Kusal Mendis and Sadeera Samarawickrama provide batting stability, while Angelo Mathews showcases all-round prowess. Dilshan Madushanka, Matheesha Pathirana, and Nuwan Thushara form a potent pace trio, complemented by Maheesh Theekshana's return, boosting the spin department. Sri Lanka boasts an unbeaten record in T20I series against Bangladesh, setting the stage for a gripping battle. Will the Lankans extend their dominance? Or can the Bangla Tigers seize an early series lead? The answer awaits on the field.
